title: Etheria
description: Seamless private SMPs, built around AutoModpack
body:
![Etheria title text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de4eb196c589f4e098c42e7c2d5cec93effd87a8.png)

Run plug and play private SMPs with friends! Thanks to AutoModpack, enjoy features such as:
- Seamless player updates when you update your modpack
- Direct & Respectful downloads from Modrinth API
- Optional Server or Client side only mods

When connecting to an AutoModpack-supported server, simply paste in the certificate fingerprint provided by the server owner. AutoModpack handles downloading mods, configs and restarting the game for you!

## Etheria's Goals
- Out of the box optimisation
- Minimal interference with modpacks - no minimaps or gameplay-changing mods included by defaul

**Only use on servers you trust!** AutoModpack allows servers to send files to your PC. Malicious server owners/admins can send harmful files.

For **server owners**, please read the [AutoModpack docs](https://moddedmc.wiki/en/project/automodpack/latest/docs/quick-start) to configure your server
